admin.title: Admin
admin.description: Manage sources, categories and system health.
admin.onlyAdmins: This section is for administrators only
admin.onlyAdminsHint: Your role is analyst. Ask an administrator to change sources or categories.

statusHelp.degraded: Works, but is slow, flapping, or its feed has not updated for a long time.
statusHelp.down: Three or more failures in a row.
statusHelp.blocked: The site answered with 403, 429 or a CAPTCHA/Cloudflare challenge — it is not bypassed.
statusHelp.auth_missing: An API key or login is not configured (backend/.env).

adminCategories.intro: Categories group events and decide which ones raise a notification. Rules assign new events to a category automatically.

empty.title: No categories yet
empty.description: Categories appear here once they are created. Without them every event is filed under "Other".

list.label: Categories in display order
list.systemHelp: Built-in category: it can be disabled but not deleted.
list.reorderFailed: Could not save the new order.

form.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and single dashes, e.g. "data-leak". It cannot be changed later.
form.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and single dashes only (2–48 characters).
form.name: Name
form.nameRequired: Enter a name in every language.
form.severityHelp: Default severity of events in this category.
form.notifyHelp: New events in this category appear in the bell.
form.retentionInvalid: Enter a whole number of days, 1 or more.
form.enabledHelp: Disabled categories receive no new events.
form.enabledLockedHelp: "Other" is the fallback category and cannot be disabled.
form.disableWarn: New events will no longer be assigned to this category. Press save again to confirm.

rules.title: Classification rules
rules.intro: An event goes to the category with the highest score. A title match gives 2 points, a text match 1, a pattern 3; the sum is multiplied by the weight.
rules.stemsHelp: One per line. These are word beginnings; a trailing space means a whole word.
rules.excludeHelp: One per line. If any matches, the event is not put in this category.
rules.minScoreHelp: Events scoring less are ignored (0–100). Default 1.
rules.invalidLine: Line {line} is not a valid expression: {message}

delete.confirmBody: The category will be removed. Its events are not deleted — they move to "Other".
delete.done: Deleted. {count, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} moved to "Other".

reclass.title: Re-classify events
reclass.intro: Runs the current rules over saved events. First you see what would change; nothing is saved until you press Apply.
reclass.lockedHelp: Events whose category you set by hand are never changed.
reclass.noChanges: Nothing would change. The current categories already match the rules.
reclass.applyHelp: This updates the events listed above and cannot be undone automatically.
reclass.appliedBody: {changed, plural, one {# event changed category} other {# events changed category}}, {severity, plural, one {# changed severity only} other {# changed severity only}}.

adminSources.intro: Every place the platform collects events from. Test a source before relying on it; a test never stores anything.
adminSources.importBadJson: The file is not valid JSON.
adminSources.importBadShape: Unexpected file format: expected a JSON export with a "sources" list.
adminSources.importBadItem: Item {n} of the file is invalid: it needs a name, a kind and a config object.
adminSources.classifierHelp: No fixed category: the classifier picks one for every event.
adminSources.emptyText: Sources are the feeds, sites and channels events are collected from. Add one to start collecting; it will appear here with its health.
adminSources.emptyFilterText: Change or reset the filters to see the other sources.

test.title: Test result
test.noSamples: No items passed the filters, so there is nothing to show.

runs.title: Run history
runs.empty: No runs recorded yet. Runs appear here after the scheduler or "Run now" fetches this source.

form.name: Name
form.kindFixed: The kind cannot be changed after the source is created.
form.advancedHelp: The whole config object. Changes here and in the fields above stay in sync.
form.jsonNotObject: The config must be a JSON object.
form.categoryHelp: If set, every event from this source gets this category.
form.regionFilterHelp: Keep only items that mention Central Asia.
form.cyberFilterHelp: Keep only items about cyber security.
form.translateHelp: Send this source's text to the translation service.
form.enabledHelp: A disabled source is never fetched.
form.jitterHelp: Random spread so requests are not perfectly regular.
form.backfillHelp: How far back the first fetch looks.
form.apiKeyHint: Name of the environment variable, e.g. OTX_API_KEY. The value itself lives in backend/.env and is never shown here.
form.keyRequired: This kind requires an API key.
form.keyOptional: This kind works without a key but is limited; a key lifts the limit.
form.testHint: Fetches the source with these settings without saving anything.
form.intervalMin: The interval must be at least 60 seconds.

tg.none: No chats found in your Telegram account.
tg.manualHint: You can still type the chat manually.

delete.title: Delete "{name}"?
delete.body: The source and its run history will be removed and it will stop being fetched. Events already collected stay and keep the source name.

disable.title: Disable "{name}"?
disable.body: The source will no longer be fetched. Events already collected stay. You can enable it again at any time.

adminSystem.intro: Health of the background services: collecting, translation, the Telegram link and who can sign in.

collector.title: Collector
collector.hint: The background worker that fetches every source on its schedule.
collector.lockHelp: Only one process collects at a time; the lock prevents duplicate fetches and duplicate events.
collector.noSources: No sources yet. Add one on the Sources tab.

translation.title: Translation (self-hosted NLLB)
translation.hint: Events are translated into English, Russian and Uzbek by our self-hosted NLLB translation service.
translation.notConfiguredHelp: Set TRANSLATE_API_URL in backend/.env and restart the backend. Until then translations stay "pending" and events show the original text.
translation.budgetExhaustedHelp: The monthly character limit is reached; translation resumes next month or when the limit is raised.
translation.keyRejectedHelp: The translation service rejected the requests. Check TRANSLATE_API_URL and the service settings.
translation.pendingNote: Pending items wait for the provider to be configured.
translation.requeued: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} requeued.

telegram.title: Telegram connection
telegram.hint: The account the platform uses to read public Telegram channels.
telegram.notConfiguredHelp: Telegram API credentials are not set in backend/.env, so Telegram channels are not collected.
telegram.reloginHelp: Telegram revoked the saved session. Someone must log in again on the server by running this command and entering the code Telegram sends:
telegram.noChats: No filter: all chats the account can read are used.

users.title: Users
users.hint: Who can sign in and what they can do. Admins manage sources; analysts only read.
users.confirmToAdmin: {email} will become an administrator and will be able to change sources, categories and users.
users.confirmToAnalyst: {email} will lose administrator rights and will no longer see the Admin section.
users.confirmActivate: {email} will be able to sign in again.
users.confirmDeactivate: {email} will be signed out and will not be able to sign in until activated again. The last active administrator cannot be deactivated.

auth.registerSubtitle: Register with your email and a password.
auth.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
auth.closedText: New accounts cannot be created right now. If you already have one, sign in or contact the administrator.

username.label: Username
username.title: Telegram username
username.pageDesc: Checks a Telegram account by username or ID: ID, usernames, username changes and shared groups.

email.label: Email
email.title: Email check
email.pageDesc: Checks the address syntax, MX records (mail server) and the Gravatar profile.

phone.label: Phone
phone.title: Phone check
phone.pageDesc: Identifies the number's country, carrier, type and time zone (offline).

domain.label: Domain / IP
domain.title: Domain / IP / WHOIS
domain.pageDesc: Collects DNS records, WHOIS, subdomains and network (ASN) data for a domain or IP.

checks.0: Account ID, type and flags (bot, premium, scam)
checks.2: Username history, recorded by the platform on every search
checks.3: Shared groups and message counts in them

checks.5: For IPs: reverse DNS (PTR) and network owner

search.noFilterDesc: Pick another filter or run a new search.
search.disclaimer: Public sources only. Results are approximate — verify manually before drawing conclusions.

export.jsonAria: Download the report as a JSON file
export.pdfAria: Print the report or save it as PDF (opens in a new window)

common.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
common.networkError: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection or that the backend is running.
